units.locator: Article 72. Repeal of certain legislative acts
units.text: The following shall be repealed from the date this Federal Law enters into force:
units.label: Art. 72 · “The following shall be repealed from the date this Federal Law…”

units.locator: Article 72. Repeal of certain legislative acts
units.text: 1) Federal Law No. 119-ФЗ of 31 July 1995 ‘On the Fundamentals of State Service of the Russian Federation’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 1995, No. 31, Art. 2990);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Repeal of certain legislative acts
units.text: 2) Federal Law No. 35-ФЗ of 18 February 1999 ‘On Amending Article 6 of the Federal Law “On the Fundamentals of State Service of the Russian Federation”’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 1999, No. 8, Art. 974);
units.label: Point 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Repeal of certain legislative acts
units.text: 3) Article 1 of Federal Law No. 135-ФЗ of 7 November 2000 ‘On Amendments and Additions to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation in Connection with Adoption of the Federal Law “On State Fingerprint Registration in the Russian Federation”’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2000, No. 46, Art. 4537).
units.label: Point 3 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 73. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions
units.text: Article 73. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions
units.label: Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions
units.text: Federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation containing labour law provisions shall apply to relations connected with civil service insofar as they are not regulated by this Federal Law.
units.label: Art. 73 · text

units.locator: Article 74. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts on state service in connection with the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: Article 74. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts on state service in connection with the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.label: Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Application of laws and other regulatory legal acts on state service in connection with the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: Until federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on state service are brought into conformity with this Federal Law, those laws and other regulatory legal acts on state service shall apply insofar as they do not conflict with this Federal Law.
